slots.title: Experts divided over Binance hack asset freezes, warn recovery is another matter
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Tether, Circle and others moved within hours to block billions in stolen crypto, but legal experts question whether smaller victims would get the same protection.

slots.title: Wall Street analysts urge investors to buy crypto stocks after $6.3 billion Binance hack
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Analysts at Cantor Fitzgerald, TD Cowen and Compass Point say the $6.3 billion Binance hack is unlikely to derail the crypto market's recovery.

slots.title: AI law firm Crosby bids on disintegrating, famed firm Weil Gotshal
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Like a real-life episode of "Suits," the demise of famed white-shoe Wall Street law firm Weil, Gotshal & Manges has been the talk of the legal industry. And now an AI firm has entered the picture.

slots.title: Binance uncovers wider breach in $6.3 billion exploit, targets Sunday withdrawal restart
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: CEO Richard Teng said hackers erased evidence and bypassed security checks. Binance plans to publish its proof of reserves Monday.

slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Can't agree on where to eat? Zest's AI concierge can combine everyone's tastes, put restaurant options to a vote, and make the reservation.
